Keep per-window evidence, known bills, logical timelines, and existing explicit-null callback-role behavior unchanged.

Positive split/simultaneous and known contiguous partial controls prevent conflating missing-window coverage with incomplete execution, non-main purpose, or missing billing. A fresh CLI process closes the gap between direct derive tests and the supported command/output artifact.
